correctness.rationale: The maximal-rank square-zero image/kernel parametrization and exact transversality count are complete. Complementarity gives block commutator diag(AB,-BA) and a uniform GL_m product. Cyclicity is characterized by coprime opposite characteristic polynomials, leading to the conjugacy-class Euler factors. Dividing by the full GL cycle index yields an analytic quotient on |z|<sqrt(q); elementary opposite-polynomial and quadratic-character identities evaluate it as the claimed rational constant. Independent brute-force checks cover 13,957 GL matrices and 44,173 square-zero ordered pairs in prime fields.

value.rationale: Cyclicity is a natural complete-module generation invariant for finite-field matrices, and the restricted random commutator model is motivated by two-square-zero decompositions. The result determines a uniform-conjugacy pushforward for all invertible commutators, gives an exact Euler generating function, and exhibits an all-dimensions characteristic-two obstruction versus a positive odd-characteristic density with a closed rational factor. These are not merely a small parameter gain or sample table.
